    Dimension recurrence from a strict right tau-sequence #

    For a strict right tau-sequence X₁ ⟶ X₂ ⟶ X₃, evaluation at a source object W gives a short exact sequence

    0 ⟶ Hom(W,X₁) ⟶ Hom(W,X₂) ⟶ rad(W,X₃) ⟶ 0.

    This file constructs the radical as a linear subspace and proves the resulting finite-dimensional equality. It is the linear-algebraic heart of the mesh/ Hom inverse recurrence.
